name: bamboohr-mcp
description: Ask Claude about your BambooHR data: who is out, vacation balances, employee fields and tables, training and holidays. Read-only, with a field allow-list, compensation and identity fields blocked, per-call record caps and a local audit log.
long_description:
Connects Claude Desktop to BambooHR with your own API key. You see at most what you can see in BambooHR; the connector never creates, approves or changes anything.

**Use cases**

- Absence planning: who is out this week, which requests are waiting for approval, which public holidays are left.
- Vacation follow-up: unplanned vacation days per employee in a department and who has not taken a continuous 14-day block.
- Employee lookups: hire date, job title, supervisor, work contact details and company-specific custom fields such as shoe size or equipment.
- Small targeted reports: a few work-related fields for a named department, location or list of employees.
- Training compliance: required training types and one employee's completed trainings.
- Access reviews: BambooHR login accounts and recent record changes.

**Hardened by design**

- The install dialog asks for the API key as a sensitive field, so Claude Desktop keeps it in the operating system credential store (Keychain, DPAPI, Secret Service) rather than in a config file, and the connector copies it into the same store under its own name. A terminal `enroll` command does the same without Claude Desktop.
- Standard employee fields are allow-listed in code. Custom fields must pass a field-type check and a blocked-name list (English and Estonian), or an explicit per-install allow-list. Pay, bank, tax, national id, date of birth, home contact and similar fields are refused and scrubbed from every response.
- Compensation, bonus, commission and bank tables are blocked. Dependents and employee files are disabled unless an administrator enables them.
- Sick leave is reduced to a generic absence and cannot be selected by type. Bulk retrieval is capped per call and needs an explicit employee or filter.
- Every call is written to a local, owner-only audit log without values or names. Free text from BambooHR is marked as untrusted data.

Read-only usage limits are enforced by this connector, but an API key that has write access in BambooHR always carries risk. Use a key with the narrowest access level you can. The repository owner accepts no responsibility for any use of this software.

subdomain.title: BambooHR subdomain
subdomain.description: The first part of your BambooHR address only: "acme" for acme.bamboohr.com.

api_key.title: BambooHR API key
api_key.description: In BambooHR, click your photo (bottom left) > API Keys > Add New Key. Claude Desktop keeps this in your operating system credential store; the connector copies it into the same store under its own name and never writes it to a config file or a log.

vacation_type.title: Vacation time-off type (optional)
vacation_type.description: Name of the time-off type that counts as vacation, e.g. "Vacation" or "Pohipuhkus". Leave empty to detect it automatically.
